# Tilt C64 disassembly - working notes

* Build + verify: `./build.sh` (KickAssembler at /opt/KickAss.jar). Both `build/tilt.prg`
  (game image $0334-$FFFF) and `build/tilt.crt` must stay byte-identical to the originals
  (`bin/Tilt.crt`) unless a change is intentional.
* `src/tilt.asm` is GENERATED by `tools/regen.sh` from `tools/tilt_annotations.py` and
  `tools/ann_*.py` (merged in file name order; later files override). Edit those and
  regenerate; do not hand-edit `src/tilt.asm` until the user decides to freeze the generator.
* `src/cart.asm` is hand-written (loader, viewer, CRT packing); it loads `build/tilt.prg`.
* Annotation keys are addresses (load = run time, no relocation). `REGIONS` in
  tilt_annotations.py: code / data / binary (written to src/bin/*.bin) / fill.
  `BASES` turn font / sprite / screen addresses into `char(n)`, `sprite(n)`, `screen+r*40+c`.
* Code/data separation uses emulator coverage (`tools/coverage/*.pkl`, from
  `tools/coverage.py` run on `build/snapshot.pkl` made by `tools/snapshot.py`) plus static
  tracing; `ENTRY_POINTS` adds unreached code.
* VICE is the flatpak `net.sf.VICE`; ROMs for the emulator are read from the flatpak
  (`VICE_ROMS` env var overrides).
* Game facts: walls kill (sprite 3 vs background collision), fire opens gates for a moment,
  POWER = energy (clunks drain it, BACKUP = last reserve), exit hole = sprites 6/7.
  Gate mask bit = gate KIND (1 fire gate, 0 tilt gate opened by tilting against it), not presence.
  Confirmed by the user: 1 level = mazes 0-3, then the mazes repeat with a bigger ball and
  another gate ("trap") layout; floor marks turn into power; end-of-maze bonus is x2 when the
  maze was finished. The $FB/$FE "special cells" are unconfirmed.
* Code checksum $0980-$8DFF at start-up ($0827): changed code triggers the tamper glyph.
* Docs: README.md, docs/memory_map.md, docs/mazes/ (`python3 tools/mazeview.py`).
* `packages/tilt-mod/src` is HAND-EDITED (copy of src/ with same-size patches marked
  `tilt-mod:` + maze_loader.asm at $C000); regen.sh never touches it. Maze sets are JSON
  (tools/mazes.py); `python3 packages/tilt-mod/tools/test_mod.py set.json N` plays N mazes
  in the emulator. The loader can't live at $A000-$BFFF (BASIC ROM shows while a bank is read).
* `packages/level-editor`: Vite/TS editor (`npm run dev`, port 5181, `npm test`).
  `public/tilt-assets.json` comes from `tools/editor_assets.py`.
